newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed at start of new month.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed at start of new month.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at noon, with consumer demand staying weak at the start of the new trading month except for news of some SMR20 shortcovering by dealers for earlier sales to China.
"Dealers are hoping to buy SMR20 to cover positions offered earlier to China," said a trader.
"But they are looking at around 240 (cents a kg), a level which sellers are unlikely to touch at the present moment," added the trader.
A check with trading houses at noon showed the SMR20 trading at around 243 cents a kg, the SMR5 at 255, the SMR10 at 245, the SMR L at 292 and SMR CV at 311. Drum latex was quoted at 212.

At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted the benchmark August RSS1 at 256.50 cents ($1.02) a kg, down three cents from Monday's close. The board priced the SMR20 1.5 cents higher at 246.50.
An official trade source said there was no news of any business transacted by midday. He added that prices were following the mixed trend on Tokyo futures.
